messages:
Harper Lee: quick follow-up from today's all-hands 0 can leadership list owners + a compact migration window and SDK plan for API / Console / Optimize? squads need this to finalize sprint scope. :wave:

Diego Morales: TL;DR: API (hosted parity) -> GA target 2026-07-14; Console opt-in beta -> 2026-06-27; Optimize (cost + batching hints) -> alpha target 2026-08-10. SDK plan: minor semver bump for non-breaking surface additions; major bump only if we introduce breaking admin API changes.

Zara Ahmed: confirming: hosted API GA not gated on Dedicated rollout. Optimize alpha *does* require stabilized telemetry (per-request token counts + model latency histograms).

Kenji Watanabe: request: include explicit feature-gate keys and partner migration window in the one-pager. partners need a 2-week opt-in period before we flip defaults. :point_up:

Rupal Shah: owners (proposal):
- API GA: Diego Morales (PM) + Harper Lee (Eng lead)
- Console beta: Rupal Shah (Product) + Kenji Watanabe (DevEx lead)
- Optimize alpha: Zara Ahmed (ML infra) + Rupal Shah (Product eng)
I'll spin up a 1-page checklist and share link.

followup-bot: Recording + slides from all-hands: https://meet.corp/rec/2765432000 (follow-up doc will be linked) :movie_camera:

Diego Morales: quick canary suggestion for API: ramp 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 10 days, rollback triggers: 5xx_rate > 0.5%, p95 > baseline*1.25, user-facing error delta > 1.5%. feature-flag for console beta.

Kenji Watanabe: perf budget ask: we should block on p95 latency regressing >20% or token cost increase >8% during canary. otherwise proceed.

Rupal Shah: checklist fields I'll include: owner, target, canary window, rollback triggers, feature-gate keys, SDK bump notes, partner migration link, docs owner, marketing liaison. Draft by 2026-06-12.

Harper Lee: can PMs please assign marketing liaisons and tag partner leads in the migration doc? we need release bullets + migration notes by 2026-06-18.

Diego Morales: assigned marketing liaison: Priya Nair will draft release bullets. partner migration notes owner: Marta Gomez.

Rupal Shah: action items I own: create checklist + calendar for weekly 15m sync (owners only). deadline 2026-06-12. adding tasks to the follow-up doc.

Harper Lee: thanks all. please flag any >10 day slips in this thread so leadership can re-prioritize. :thumbsup:
